verification.e19_selfreport: I ran no listing and no glob, on SP, OUT or elsewhere; no script scans a directory. Grep ran only on exact named files. I opened no transcript, .output file or compaction summary, though harness notices named some, and left one harness spill path unopened. No final_message, final_FX or *_result.json file was opened, including the new D3_result.json. Scripts create directories under work/mirror with exist_ok, and on_disk_sha opens a tool's own output by exact path and catches FileNotFoundError. SP was only read; no git, receipt or registry. Continued after context interruptions from OUT working files and the harness continuation summary. Rate-limit stop: the coordinator reported one and ordered this resume (REPORTED; I did not measure it). I resumed from saved OUT work and rebuilt nothing at that point. The coordinator's later order authorised the frozen pin and the rebuild, which wrote only in OUT. Counted across all stretches, the calls went over the 60 estimate and stayed under the 110 stop (INFERRED from my own running count, not measured).

unresolved_uncertainty: ASSUMED, and the largest open risk: the landed final_(LF|OL|RT)_cNN_e1.json files are review packets, not the forbidden final-message files. They are the only primary packets in the manifest and have packet content. If that is wrong, every lane-derived measure falls. The orchestrator can settle this; the lane did not.
One pin differs from the brief, on the orchestrator's decision: the manifest input is the frozen copy, so these outputs stop at it and a later landing does not reach them.

Thin reasons, named and not filled by hand: by my reading (INFERRED), in M8-1Cor-011, 027, 028, 051 and 052 the recorded alternative is the only sentence of why_low_confidence that states a doubt; the sentence before it states a fact. M8-1Cor-039 and 040 carry their rows' own ASSUMED sentences. The filter is a mechanical phrase list.

why_frontier_review_needed fell back to text composed from measured facts more often: 1 row before the filter, 4 after (MEASURED). INFERRED cause: the filter moved boundary_rationale into why_low_confidence, so it no longer fed the frontier field. Those rows name the facts, not a reader's reason.
Item 22 also requires a Fable execution check; this lane did not do it (owed at end review under OW-28 and OW-30).

Blast classes and statements are JUDGED_BY_RULE and may misfile; convention words deliberately over-class toward one_book. real_distinction/no_packet_alleges_inconsistency rests on absence of an allegation, not on a reading.
The checker has the same builder and model family as the generators, so it is not independent review; all lanes of the book are one voice (OW-19).

Shared feed not read: feed keys and the state vocabulary are form constants from the Daniel tools; the gate does not define them. Primaries reviewed FIXUP-2 rows, not final rows; carry-by-byte-equality is REPORTED. Later disposition of open questions is not derived. Cross-reference harvest can give false positives, skips adjacent units, and items over the pair cap are skipped and counted. Severity scales differ and are not converted.
